description: SWB2 is the U.S. Geological Survey's second-generation Soil-Water-Balance code for estimating groundwater recharge. It combines GIS grid layers with tabular climate inputs in a modified Thornthwaite-Mather daily water balance. Inputs describe land cover, soils, climate and model grid cells; outputs include recharge and related water-balance quantities that can feed regional groundwater-flow models. The user sets the grid extent and period. Daily calculations can be aggregated to monthly or annual recharge. The repository documents a 2026 version 2.4.1 software release and links an official manual. Its README states that this USGS code is in the public domain and shows a CC0 notice. A limitation is that recharge depends on spatial data and land-surface assumptions, which require local checking. This is a groundwater boundary-input model, not a groundwater-flow solver. The older SWB 1.x repository itself advises users to prefer SWB2. No climate grids or model binaries were downloaded. It supports water-supply and drought scenario simulations through its recharge outputs.
inputs: Daily climate tables and recharge parameters
